description: This file defines Pydantic models for notification data structures used in the gym management system backend API, including base notification fields, creation payload, response models, and paginated list responses.

classes.name: NotificationBase
classes.description: Base model for notification data, shared across create and update operations.

classes.name: NotificationCreate
classes.description: Model for creating a new notification, inherits from NotificationBase.

classes.name: NotificationOut
classes.description: Model for notification response, includes additional fields like id, sent_at, read_at, and metadata.

classes.name: NotificationListResponse
classes.description: Model for paginated list of notifications, containing list of NotificationOut items and pagination info.
